design_brief.description: Parametric CAD model of a small brushless DC outrunner motor consisting of a cylindrical motor body (rotor/stator can), a slightly larger circular base plate, and a centered cylindrical shaft protruding from the base plate along the motor axis.

metadata.description: Parametric small brushless DC outrunner motor: cylindrical body, slightly larger base plate at Z0, and centered shaft protruding in +Z. Includes placeholder expected parts (veroboard_base, buzzer, pcb_base, right_trapezoid) merged into one connected solid.

primary_dimension_mm.description: Primary anchor size; motor body diameter is derived from this.

base_plate_diameter_mm.description: Base plate diameter (slightly larger than body).

shaft_length_mm.description: Shaft length protruding in +Z from base plate.

interface_step_height_mm.description: Small interface step height between base plate and body.

interface_step_diameter_mm.description: Interface step diameter (slightly smaller than body).

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: A brushless DC outrunner motor: 9 mm body diameter, 8 mm body height, 10 mm base plate diameter, 1 mm shaft diameter, 15.5 mm shaft length.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): motor_body_cylinder, base_plate_disc, center_shaft, veroboard_base, buzzer, pcb_base, orientate_axial, right_trapezoid
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — primary_dimension = 9mm (category: generic).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: body_diameter_mm≈9.0mm, body_height_mm≈8.0mm, base_plate_diameter_mm≈10.0mm, base_plate_thickness_mm≈1.0mm, shaft_diameter_mm≈1.0mm, shaft_length_mm≈15.5mm
NOTE: No mounting holes, wire leads, chamfers, or surface details were specified; model should remain a simplified envelope representation.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
